thread:
elena: Heads-up from legal: they want a defensible export showing "who changed routing policies" for subpoenas. Small proposal meeting here so we can align on API+console.

mike: OK. quick list of must-haves: immutable event IDs, signed bundle, actor resolution snapshot, export auth + entitlement check. Format: NDJSON preferred.

elena: Also must ensure we don't accidentally leak sensitive headers or tokens. Default safe-mode: drop auth headers & request bodies unless explicitly requested by SOC.

raj: Implementation sketch: worker will stream NDJSON into chunks (e.g., 50MB) into a temp bucket, keep a manifest that lists chunk keys + crc32 checksums + event_count. Each NDJSON line contains: event_id, ts, tenant_id, actor_id, action, resource_id, compact_diff, trace_id?, rollout_id?.

jess: Ops constraints: exports are heavy. We need per-org monthly export byte quotas + concurrent job limit (default 1). UI should surface current usage and estimated cost before confirm.

mike: Signature plan: sign the manifest with a durable export key (ed25519). Manifest includes job_id, requested_by, time_range, options (pseudonymize:true/false), and per-chunk checksums. Signature proves bundle integrity.

elena: For pseudonymization: replace actor_id with stable pseudo (p_<hash>) per-job, and include a separate file actor_map.json.asc encrypted with org KMS so only org admins (with KMS access) can re-identify. By default we do not include emails in clear.

raj: Two notes: 1) add `preview_sample_size` to show N example events for the console preview; 2) support `include_actor_snapshot` boolean which adds a small NDJSON snapshot actor_id -> {display_name,email_hash,resolved_at}. This is optional because it increases size.

tariq: Telemetry: include trace_id, route_eval_id, policy_version, and cluster_id. That allows console to link to request traces and policy diffs.

jess: API proposal: POST /v1/audit/exports {tenant_ids[], from, to, format:ndjson, pseudonymize:boolean, include_actor_snapshot:boolean, preview_sample_size:int, notify:string} -> 202 {job_id, estimated_size_bytes, preview:{events,unique_actors,size_est}}.

mike: GET /v1/audit/exports/:job_id -> {status, created_by, started_at, completed_at, presigned_urls:[...], manifest_signatures:[...]} When completed return a signed zip or a folder of signed chunks.

elena: TTLs: presigned_url default 7d but enterprise may set shorter/longer. Also add `presigned_ttl` param but limit by policy.

raj: Redaction modes: none | mask_pii | strip_sensitive. We should have server-side rules for field paths to redact (e.g., request.headers.authorization). Provide a schema and a small rules DSL.

jess: Quotas and UX: console flow: 1) choose tenants + window, 2) system shows event count estimate + unique actors + estimated bytes + quota impact, 3) choose pseudonymize/redaction mode + preview sample size, 4) confirm -> job queued. If over quota show reason + support-bypass flow.

mike: Security: export endpoints require org-admin role + 2FA for large windows (e.g., >30d) or high data volume. Log `export_request` metric with sampling.

elena: Legal: needs provenance mapping. We'll record actor_resolution_snapshot and a per-event `actor_resolution_id` pointing at the snapshot entry. That way each event references the identity mapping captured at time-of-change.

raj: On chunking: provide `cursor` and `chunk_index` fields so consumers can stream-replay. Also add `partial:true` on chunked responses so clients know whether dataset is complete.

audit-bot: export job 5234567999-0 created by elena (preview run). size_est 12.3MB. ETA ~30s.

elena: Ownership: mike - API + signing; raj - worker + chunking; jess - quotas + console; tariq - telemetry fields + links. I'll draft the RFC and include sample NDJSON event spec.

mike: One more: manifest will include a bounded proof object: {job_id, root_hash_of_chunks, signer, signed_at}. Include an endpoint to fetch the public key used for verification.

jess: Also enforce retention policy compliance: if requested window goes beyond tenant retention, warn & require justification.

elena: Great. I'll post the RFC link here once done and open a tiny design PR for console mockups. If anyone sees a compliance hole call it out.

raj: Add default `preview_sample_size` = 5. Also include `estimated_unique_actors` in preview.

mike: ok locking in.

elena: Thanks all, closing thread. :raised_hands:
